verdict.rationale: Ente publishes a first-party self-hosting guide that walks users through running Ente Auth locally (localhost:3003) against their own instance. Its llms.txt states that Ente's apps and server are open source, which a community comment echoes. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of server deployment and configuration steps (e.g., containers, storage, pointing mobile and desktop clients at a custom server), and independent hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted Auth setup.
